lines: When proof has melted into Śiva-step-shining glory — body-breath measured into knower-standing —
when time's frame meets Your dissolving step — then she who shines, mine, would be Śiva-made.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pramāṇe saṃlīne śivapadalasadvaibhavavaśāt | tadā devī yāsau lasati mama sā syāc chivamayī
